app_name: AgriSutra - Autonomous Farmer & FPO Marketplace Engine
emotional_tone: Empowering, transparent, deeply grounded, trustworthy, modern rural-tech

layouts.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen w-64 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 z-40

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully interactive hybrid full-stack Agri Marketplace dashboard in React JS (.js files) with Tailwind CSS, supporting Farmer, Buyer, FPO, and Admin roles.

Implement the exact guided farmer selling workflow: Crop Entry -> AI Agent Collection -> Market & Buyer Demand -> Net Realisation calculation -> Sell Now vs Store comparison -> Top 3 options -> Offer Generation -> Transaction Execution -> EVM Testnet Recording.
Ensure all calculations (transportation, commission, net realization) are performed deterministically in backend/frontend logic, with the AI Agent explaining the numbers rather than inventing them.
Support English and Hindi language switching with interactive voice input/output simulation and text AI Assistant chat.
Include Digital Lot Management, Quality Assessment grading, Logistics calculator, FPO aggregation, Blockchain verification explorer on EVM testnet, Dispute management, and WhatsApp notification logs.
Ensure all interactive elements and buttons include `data-testid` attributes for automated testing.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or full transparent headers; maintain warm earthy tones (#1E5128 primary, #F4F6F0 background).
